script.title: Why India’s $1.6B AI Boom Is a Trap #shorts

segments.text: AI funding in India jumped 96%, yet most founders are starving.
broll_alt: data center server corridor slow motion

segments.text: How can funding nearly double when total deal counts crashed 42%?
broll_alt: stressed man staring at laptop screen
red stock market ticker display screen

segments.text: Big venture capital funds are placing massive bets on just a few giants.
segments.broll: close up counting Indian rupee notes
broll_alt: business executives shaking hands boardroom wide
stack of currency notes on table

segments.text: Building core AI tech requires hundreds of crores in computing power and elite talent.
segments.broll: programmer coding on computer screen close up
broll_alt: fingers typing fast on backlit keyboard

segments.text: So basic wrapper apps get zero paisa, while top players bag all the cash.
segments.broll: empty coffee cup on office desk
broll_alt: young man resting head on desk tired

segments.text: Without proprietary data or breakthrough tech, surviving this wave is brutally hard.
segments.broll: drone shot glass tech park building daylight

segments.text: It turns out big money creates a winner-take-all market. Not financial advice.
segments.broll: young entrepreneur looking out office window sunset
broll_alt: person walking through corporate glass hallway

script.description: India's AI funding surged 96% to $1.6 billion, but total startup deals fell by 42%. Here is why big venture funds are only backing a handful of tech giants. #IndianStartups #AIFunding #PaisaDecoded

facts_to_verify.claim: India's AI funding jumped 96% to $1.6 billion
AI deal volume in India fell 42%

script.chosen_candidate: India’s AI funding nearly doubles to $1.6 billion, but a handful of deals drive the surge: Report - Fortune India
script.why_it_will_work: It taps into the current hype around AI while revealing a shocking counter-intuitive business truth: funding doubled yet 42% fewer startups got funded.
